Call me Fives.''"<br />"''But five is a number.''"<br />"''No, not five, Fives.''"<br />"''Oh. The difference is minimal.''"<br />"''Not to me. And not to any clone.|Fives and AZI-3|<ref name="Conspiracy">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref>}}
'''Fives''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Because of his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] designation, '''CT-27-5555''', or '''CT-5555''' for short, he took the name "Fives." Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Fives was assigned to [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]], a [[Squad/Legends|unit]] of [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] that trained within the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] [[clone military education complex]], under the command of the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Bric/Legends|Bric]]. Fives and his squad were required to pass a [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|test]] in order to become battle-ready clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. After the completion of their training, Fives, along with a number of other [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] clone troopers, was assigned to [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] located on the [[Rishi moon|moon]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Fives was present when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|invaded]] the moon to take control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] listening post. With the arrival of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], the two clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] helped Fives and the surviving rookie troops retake the outpost.

Fives and trooper [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], the only rookie survivors of the battle, were rewarded with medals for their service on the Rishi moon and were inducted into the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. They later helped defend Kamino after Grievous, along with [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|invaded]] the planet and attacked [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]]. Following the Confederate attack on Kamino, Fives and Echo were promoted to [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] for their continuous efforts, with Fives being also known as '''ARC-5555'''. As the war continued, both Fives and Echo joined [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] from the Confederate [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]]. After they rescued Piell and his officers, the facility's warden, [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]], released [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces on Fives and the Republic group. While Echo and Piell [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the battle, Fives and the surviving members of his team were rescued by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].

Some time later, Fives was assigned on special assignments to the 501st legion during the attack on Umbara. When General [[Pong Krell]] took over command from Anakin Skywalker, Fives was the loudest voice against Krell and his leadership. Fives was later proven correct when Krell revealed himself to be working against the Republic. Fives was also present during the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]]. When his friend [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] went crazy and killed [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]], Fives took him back to Kamino for further medical study. Fives found surprising evidence that contradicted what the Kaminoan scientist, [[Nala Se]] had found, which led him to conduct a full study and research on his own, hiding from Republic authorities. When Shaak Ti ordered him to present his evidence to the Chancellor, Nala Se drugged him and Palpatine faked an assassination attempt. On the run, Fives tried to convey his information to General Skywalker and Captain Rex. However, he was tracked by Commander [[Fox/Legends|Fox]] and a group of Shock Troopers. When Fives tried to defend himself, Fox shot him through the heart. Fives died knowing the truth about Chancellor Palpatine and Order 66, but was unable to communicate this to anyone.

==Biography==
===Clone cadet on Kamino===
{{Quote|Thanks, CT-27-5555. That was close."''<br />''"It's Fives. The name is ''Fives''!|Droidbait and Fives|<ref name="cc">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref>}}
CT-27-5555 was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="cc" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], CT-27-5555 was assigned to [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]], a [[Squad/Legends|unit]] of [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]].<ref name="cc" /> Due to his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] designation ending with 5555, CT-27-5555 preferred to be called "Fives."<ref name="cc" /><ref name="rookiesD">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)|d=y}}</ref> The other Domino [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]]&mdash;[[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]], [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], and [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]]&mdash;preferred to call him by his clone designation number, though Fives wanted to be called by his name. Fives and Domino Squad trained in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Kamino. Their training at the [[clone military education complex]] was overseen by the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Bric/Legends|Bric]], who also watched the squad during their combat simulation practice tests. During their simulation battles, each clone cadet, including Fives, used non-lethal weapons, so that no clone could be injured during one of their simulations. Furthermore, all clone cadet squad members had to work as a team to successfully pass the simulation. The Domino Squad clones, however, rarely got along with each other as a team.<ref name="cc" />

During one of their [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|combat simulation]] tests, Fives engaged in several arguments with fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] Droidbait, who was calling Fives by his designation number. As the test continued, Hevy broke formation from the struggling group, while Fives, Echo, Droidbait, and Cutup remained behind barricades. The training evaluators supervising the group&mdash;Bric, the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[El-Les/Legends|El-Les]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]&mdash;took concern with Domino Squad's recklessness. Since Domino Squad could not work as a team, Fives and the rest of the squad failed the test, and the squad departed to the complex's [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]]. After returning to the barracks, Echo and Hevy got into an argument and then a fight, but the brawl was broken up by the immediate arrival of Bric. The Siniteen Sergeant wanted Fives and the rest of Domino Squad to cooperate with each other, stating that they would be a waste of his [[Time/Legends|time]] if they continued to disagree.<ref name="cc" /> The next day,<ref name="defenders">''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]''</ref> Bric and El-Les rallied Domino Squad, as well as some of Tipoca City's other clone cadet squads, for a meeting<ref name="cc" /> outside the military complex on a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] deck.<ref name="defenders" />

[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Colt/Legends|Colt]], an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]], was to watch the clone cadets' final combat simulator test. If one past the test, the troopers within the squad would be promoted to a clone trooper. Colt took interest with Bravo Squad, a clone cadet unit that had passed passed certain tests in "ARC trooper time." Since they were on-deck to take the test after Bravo Squad, Fives and Domino Squad observed the unit's test, noting their ability to work as a team. After Bravo Squad's test concluded, Fives and Domino Squad entered the simulation room and began their test, quickly completing certain parts of the simulation faster than their usual rate. As Fives, Echo, Droidbait, and Cutup took cover behind some barricades, Hevy, who was destroying [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with his [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]], cleared a path for them. When Droidbait broke away from the group, however, a droid shot him in the back. Cutup noticed this and yelled out for Hevy to stop, though Hevy wanted his team to head for the simulation's citadel tower to complete the test. However, because Fives and his squadmates left Droidbait behind, El-Les and Colt immediately ended their test and told them that they had automatically failed.<ref name="cc" />

[[File:EchoFivesRequestTramsfer-CC.png|thumb|right|250px|Echo and Fives confer with Shaak Ti.]]
After failing the test, Fives and the clone cadets returned to their sleeping quarters. For Fives and Echo, however, the two clone cadets felt that they did not belong within Domino Squad. Hoping to get transferred to a different clone cadet squad, preferably Bravo Squad, Fives and Echo went to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master Shaak Ti and requested a transfer. However, Ti denied their request and revealed that she had faith within Domino Squad. Because she had confidence in the clone cadets, she gave Domino Squad another chance to take the test. The next day,<ref name="defenders" /> Ti joined Bric, El-Les, and Colt in supervising Domino Squad's final attempt at passing the test. Fives and his comrades managed to reach the bottom of the citadel tower, at which point they noticed that the ascension cables in their belts were missing. The clones instead improvised and decided to climb the [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster turrets]] that acceded up toward the citadel's roof. Once Fives and the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] successfully climbed the turrets, Hevy himself lifted the pole on top of the citadel, which completed the test. Ti and El-Les commended Domino Squad's efforts, and due to them working as a team and completing their final test, the members of Domino Squad were allowed to become battle-ready clone troopers. They each received their own medals, as a symbol for their graduation from clone cadet.<ref name="cc" />

===Service on the moon of Rishi===
{{Quote|It's no good. Their comlinks are on a different scramble set.''"<br />"''I'll signal them with this flare.|Fives and Hevy, trying to contact Cody and Rex|<ref name="rookies" />}}
After several former members of Domino Squad&mdash;Echo, Cutup, Hevy, and Droidbait&mdash;were given their first off-world assignment, Fives was given his first assignment as well.<ref name="defenders" /> Joining his former Domino Squad teammates, Fives was stationed at a [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening post]] located on a [[Rishi moon|moon]] of the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]], Fives and the clone troopers,<ref name="rookies" /> along with troopers [[Nub/Legends|Nub]] and [[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]],<ref name="Rookies Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref> maintained the [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] to warn the Republic of any impending [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] attacks on the nearby Kamino. As O'Niner reported, Rishi Station soon became host to a clone inspection team as part of the base's routine examinations.<ref name="rookies" />

Unbeknownst to the clone troopers, however, the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] planned to attack Kamino in order to end the Republic's production of clone troopers. Grievous knew that if he attacked Kamino, the Rishi [[Moon/Legends|moon]] listening post would detect the attack, and the stationed troopers at the listening post would turn off the base's "all-clear" signal, which would alert the nearby [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] to the invasion. Grievous therefore deployed [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] in [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] to [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|take over]] the listening post. Meanwhile, a clone trooper raised the listening post's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] to protect the base against what appeared to be an approaching [[Asteroid/Legends|meteor]] shower, which was actually the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of ''Droch''-class boarding [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. The droids soon left their [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and began their attack on the Republic base. After three [[Commando/Legends|commando]] droids shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] O'Niner, Droidbait, and Nub, the remaining clone troopers&mdash;Fives, Echo, Hevy, and Cutup&mdash;evacuated the command center by exiting through a ventilation shaft, which led them outside the listening post.<ref name="rookies" />

[[File:StormTheBase-Rookies.png|thumb|left|240px|Fives (far left) and the other clone troopers storming the listening post]]
Leaving the ventilation shaft, the four rookie troopers were disheartened when a [[Rishi eel/Legends|Rishi eel]] attacked and devoured Cutup, leaving only Fives, Echo, and Hevy to defend themselves. Eventually, they sighted<ref name="rookies" /> the [[Obex/Legends|''Obex'']],<ref name="TCWTVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] flown by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. The clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] had arrived for the inspection of the listening post and were unaware of the droid attack. After the two were attacked by the invading droids, they escaped and met with Fives and the other rookie troops. Having encountered a commando droid disguised in [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|clone armor]] during their skirmish with the droids, Rex demanded that the rookies remove their helmets to verify that they were indeed clones. After the three rookie troopers obeyed and removed their headgear, another Rishi moon [[Eel/Legends|eel]] attacked them. Rex used his [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]] to kill it with a single shot to the [[Eye/Legends|eye]], a feat that impressed the rookies. When talking with the rookie troopers, Rex dubbed them "[[Shiny/Legends|shinies]],"<ref name="rookies" /> a derogatory term referring to the troopers' spotless [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that had not yet seen action in battle.<ref name="TCWTVG" />

Rex and Cody gave Fives and the other rookie troops their [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbines]], and Rex suggested a plan to retake the listening post. The group of clone troopers hid near the entrance of the base while Rex impersonated [[Unit 26/Legends|commando droid unit 26]] by using the droid's decapitated head.<ref name="rookies" /> The Clone [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] successfully tricked units [[07/Legends|07]], [[08/Legends|08]], and [[09/Legends|09]] to open the listening post's main door, allowing Fives and the clone troopers to ambush the remainder of the commando droids inside the base.<ref name="Rookies Ep Guide" /> The clones defeated the droid units, including their [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]-wielding [[Sparky/Legends|leader]]. Nevertheless, their victory was cut short when the clone troopers noticed that General Grievous's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] had arrived above the moon. Due to the lack of response from the commando droids, Grievous sent more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to the listening post. The clones, inside the command center of the listening post, were unable to turn off the "all-clear" signal because the droids had hot-wired it. Soon, a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|droid landing craft]] descended through the moon's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and landed at the listening post. With the battle droid reinforcements outnumbering the clone troopers, Rex&mdash;to the surprise of the rookie troops&mdash;ordered the complete destruction of the base.<ref name="rookies" />

[[File:FivesHonored.png|thumb|right|250px|Echo and Fives are honored by the Jedi.]]
When both Fives and Echo told the Clone Captain that their duty was to protect the base, Rex dismissed their objections, stating that if the base was destroyed, it would turn off the all-clear signal and alert the nearby Republic fleet of the impending Separatist invasion. To destroy the base, Echo offered the use of highly explosive liquid [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]], which was used as a fuel source at the station when the Rishi moon entered its freezing cycle. While Rex and Echo went to retrieve the [[PLNK-series power droid/Legends|plunk droids]] that stored the liquid tibanna, Fives, Cody, and Hevy grabbed weaponry from the listening post's supply room. With their new supply of weaponry, the clones attacked the invading battle droid forces,<ref name="rookies" /> buying time for Rex and Echo to wire the three plunk droids together.<ref name="Rookies Ep Guide" /> However, the remote activator to detonate the tibanna inside the plunk droids did not function properly.<ref name="rookies" />

Hevy offered to stay behind and correct the problem before joining the other clones as they fled the listening post through a nearby ventilation shaft. Once outside, Rex found&mdash;to his surprise&mdash;that Hevy hadn't yet evacuated the listening post. The Clone Captain contacted Hevy via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], but Hevy refused to evacuate the listening post until he was able to repair the detonator. Unwilling to accept Hevy's decision, the clones ran to rescue the rookie trooper. Before they were able to re-enter the facility, however, Hevy manually detonated the explosives. The listening post exploded, killing Hevy and all of the droid forces inside. Shortly thereafter, Rex, Cody, Fives, and Echo were picked up by an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] that carried them off the moon.<ref name="rookies" /> On board the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']],<ref name="Rookies Ep Guide" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] awarded Fives and Echo medals for their service. Following the presentation of the medals, Rex inducted the two clones into the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] for their part in helping the Republic to thwart the Separatist attack.<ref name="rookies" />

===Protecting Kamino===
{{Quote|Look around. We're one and the same: same heart, same blood.|Fives, trying to bolster the cadets' confidence|<ref name="arc">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>}}
Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the destruction of Rishi Station, Fives, with Echo, joined the 501st Legion in a number of battles throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. While stationed aboard the ''Resolute'', Fives and Echo were tasked with taking inventory of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] supplies, as well as guarding the ammunition.<ref name="defenders" /> When the Republic learned that the Confederacy was about to invade Kamino, Fives, along with Echo, Kenobi, and Skywalker, were dispatched to the world to prepare for the impending attack. While Kenobi and Skywalker met with Shaak Ti and Kamino [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]], Fives and Echo roamed through Tipoca City's military complex. The two clones soon spotted their old clone trooper friend, [[99/Legends|99]], who was glad to see them, but questioned Hevy's absence. When they revealed that Hevy had sacrificed himself to save the others on the Rishi moon, 99 showed the two Hevy's medal, and told them that Hevy had given it to him. Once Fives and Echo told 99 about the suspected Confederate invasion of Kamino, 99 departed to the facility's weaponry room to gather weapons for the clone troopers. Soon after the Confederacy began its [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|assault]] on Tipoca City, Fives and Echo met with an [[Havoc (ARC trooper)/Legends|ARC trooper]] in a docking bay at the military complex.<ref name="arc" />

[[File:EchoFives99-ARCT.png|thumb|left|240px|Echo and Fives on Kamino]]
The ARC trooper gave Fives and Echo the task of going outside on a platform bridge in [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] position to repel the invading battle droids. The two 501st troopers complied and left for the bridge, and once there, they situated themselves and prepared for battle. Separatist [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|trident drill]] craft, led by the Confederate General Grievous and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], climbed the outside structures of the city. While the ships caused structural damage to the buildings due to their drills, they also deployed [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droids]], which attacked the stationed clone troopers. On the bridge, Fives and Echo utilized their DC-15 carbine [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to shoot down the nearby droids. After 99 visited the two clones and resupplied them with ammunition and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], battle droids stormed the area, though they were destroyed when Echo tossed a detonator at them. Not long after, a squad of clone cadets approached Fives, Echo, and 99, and told them that they were lost, since they had been separated from their group. With Fives and Echo, 99 offered to bring them back to the military complex's barracks.<ref name="arc" />

Once there, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex joined the group and told Fives, Echo, and the clone cadets that they were going to fight off the droids. However, the clone cadets disagreed, due to their training being inadequate. Fives tried to boost the clone cadets' confidence, though the cadets still remained hesitant about engaging the droids. 99 entered the conversation by telling the clones that he knew where the complex's armory room was: if the clones could gather enough weaponry and supplies, they would be able to hold off the droids. After gathering the supplies, the clones repelled Grievous's droid forces, which attempted to enter the barracks. Fives and the clones began to fire at the droids, and lured them inside the barracks room. The clones took defensive positions behind crates as the droids continued their pursuit.<ref name="arc" />

Soon, however, the clones around the crates began to be overwhelmed by the droids. Rex used his comlink to alert the clone cadets, who were hidden inside the sleeping bunkers, to reveal themselves to the droids. As they began to fire at the droids, Fives and the others continued as well. However, 99 noticed that the clones were running out of thermal detonators. Despite being told not to retrieve more by Rex, since it was too dangerous, 99 ignored the order and ran toward a nearby door. Yet, battle droids fired upon the clone and killed him. After 99's death, Fives and his comrades destroyed the remainder of the droids. Grievous and Ventress were meanwhile forced to flee from Kamino, resulting in a Republic victory. Fives and Echo later joined Cody and Rex at one of the military complex's hangars. Because of their accomplishments during the invasion, both Fives and Echo became ARC troopers.<ref name="arc" />

===Citadel mission===
{{Quote|We're trusting those droids to take us into the Citadel?|Fives, to Cody|<ref name="tc">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:FivesFullARCarmor-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|Fives as an ARC trooper]]
Fives later took part in the rescue of Jedi Master [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], who had been [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|captured]] by the Confederacy, which wished to extract information about the secret [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that the Jedi Master possessed. In the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Fives and Echo joined Skywalker, Kenobi, Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], Cody, and Rex during a briefing at the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Temple's communication center]]. As they orchestrated a plan to [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|free]] Piell, the team knew that any attack on the the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], the Confederate [[Prison/Legends|facility]] in which Piell had been [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]], would be rendered useless due to its security. Skywalker, however, devised a plan of encasing the team in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in order to avoid detection, as the facility's security utilized [[Life-form scanner/Legends|lifeform scanners]]. Soon after that, his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], along with a [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron/Legends|group]] of reprogrammed B1 battle droids, would fly the carbonite blocks to the Citadel. After the meeting, Fives and the team departed to the Temple's hangar bay, where a [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbon-freezing chamber]], maintained by [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], was located. Because of the complexity of their mission, as well as noticing R2-D2's battle droid force, Fives told Cody and Rex his worries of entrusting their lives to the droids. Yet, Cody agreed with Skywalker's plan, as the droids would not be detected.<ref name="tc" />

After Fives and the team were encased in separate carbonite blocks and stored in a<ref name="tc" /> [[Class type B/Legends|Class Type B escort shuttle]], a variant of the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]],<ref name="tcep">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode318.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Citadel}}</ref> R2-D2 and the battle droids flew the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to the Citadel, located on the planet [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]]. After passing through the prison's life-form scan check, R2-D2 and the battle droids landed the shuttle near a cliff by the Citadel. R2-D2 released the team from their carbonite blocks, and they regrouped. Leaving R2-D2, the battle droids, and the shuttle behind, Skywalker and Kenobi led Fives and the team closer to the cliff's edge. Noticing that they could not utilize ascension cables to reach the top of the cliff due to touch-sensitive [[Electro-mine/Legends|electro-mines]], devices that would sound an alarm within the prison facility, along the cliff face, Skywalker and Kenobi told Fives and the rest of the team that they would have to free-climb the cliff. Near the top of the cliff, the team noticed a doorway that led into the Citadel itself was being [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]]. Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], entered the Citadel through a nearby ventilation shaft, and she deactivated the ray shield to allow the team to enter.<ref name="tc" />

Nearby the others, Fives was helping Rex and another clone, [[Charger/Legends|Charger]], reach the top of the cliff. However, when Charger grabbed Fives's hand, he slipped and free-fell down toward an electro-mine, which killed him and sounded the Citadel's alarm. Despite alerting the Citadel of their presence, Fives and the team proceeded into the prison. After entering one of the Citadel's [[detention area]] hallways, the team found out that the walls surrounding them contained hidden blaster turrets. Once the turrets revealed themselves to the group, the Jedi utilized their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] to deflect the blaster fire, while Fives and the clones fired at the turrets. Despite the setback, the team continued on and found Piell inside a holding cell, and released him from captivity. Though they rescued Piell, the Jedi Master wanted to find his officers, who had also been taken captive by the Confederacy, as one of Piell's officers, [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], held in his memory half of the coordinates of the Nexus Route; Piell was in possession of the other half. Piell and Tarkin had memorized the coordinates so that they would not fall into Confederate hands. Still within one of the Citadel's detention hallways, Echo and the team were confronted by a group of commando droids, released by the prison's warden, [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]].<ref name="tc" />

A [[Lightfight|firefight]] erupted, and the Republic team destroyed the first wave of droids. Sobeck, who was watching the fight via the prison's [[TT-8L gatekeeper droid/Legends|security camera]] system, released more droids and activated the hallway's [[Magnet/Legends|magnetized]] ceiling, which took Fives and his team's weapons, albeit leaving the commando droids' weaponry intact. The clones tried to attack the droids with [[Unarmed combat/Legends|bare hands]], while Kenobi, Tano and Piell [[Telekinesis/Legends|used]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], but neither tactic worked due to the droids being magnetized to the floor. Skywalker, however, disabled the magnetized ceiling, which allowed his team to re-equip themselves and finish off the droids. They soon located and freed Piell's men&mdash;Tarkin and several [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officers]]&mdash;from a holding cell. Believing that they might run into more trouble with Osbeck's prison guards, Kenobi decided the team should split up: Piell, half of his men, and Cody would go with Kenobi to create a diversion, while Fives, Echo, Rex, Skywalker, Tano, and Piell's other officers, including Tarkin, would stay together and find an escape route that would lead them out of the prison. With Piell and Tarkin separated, if one squad was to be captured, the enemy would only have half the information. As Kenobi's team detonated a series of explosives in one of the corridors, Skywalker cut his way through the wall to an old tunnel&mdash;of which the strike team knew thanks to some old archive data on the Citadel&mdash;and Fives and Echo resealed the entrance before continuing onward through the tunnels.<ref name="tc" />

[[File:EchoFivesARCarmor-TC.png|thumb|left|240px|Fives and Echo in their ARC trooper armor]]
Skywalker, having contacted R2-D2 and instructed him to land the shuttle near their location, led his group through the tunnels. When they reached a dead-end, they were ambushed by several commando droids, which were armed with [[Personal energy shield/Legends|energy shields]]. Without warning, Tano tossed a few thermal detonators under the droids' feet, which destroyed them. After Tano used more explosives to blow their way through the rock, Fives and the others proceeded toward a nearby pipeline. Moving on through the pipeline in search of a way to reach R2-D2's shuttle, Fives and the team soon arrived at an exit point from the pipeline. However, outside of the exit hatch, a battalion of battle and [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|crab droids]] ambushed them. The group escaped, and Skywalker tossed a grenade into the fuel line. The resulting explosion destroyed the droids. Skywalker's team went to Kenobi's position, finding the Jedi Master and his men pinned down by droids that were guarding the shuttle. Fives and Echo joined the battle, as more and more droids arrived.<ref name="ca">{{TCW|Counterattack}}</ref>

When a [[Unidentified BX-series droid commando 2 (The Citadel)/Legends|commando droid]], who was stationed on top of a watch tower, began to fire at their shuttle with a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], Echo reported this to Skywalker. Skywalker and Piell swooped in to attack on a commandeered [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAP]] but were knocked out. While Fives told Echo to stay with him, Echo was determined to protect the shuttle. When the clone picked up a fallen commando droid's shield to defend himself and attempted to reach the shuttle, the droid destroyed the Republic team's shuttle,<ref name="ca" /> killing Echo in the process.<ref name="caep">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode319.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Counterattack}}</ref> Despite Echo's sudden death, Fives and the rest of the team continued on, away from their destroyed shuttle. With the destruction of the shuttle, their only means of transport off Lola Sayu, the group contacted the Jedi Council for assistance. Plo Koon told them he would come to their aid, though they needed to proceed to a rendezvous point for extraction. Passing through the lower levels of the Citadel, Fives and the others made their way outside of the Citadel, albeit still nearby the facility itself. Still being hunted by Sobeck's droid force, R2-D2's battle droid force was determined to stay behind, while Fives and the rest of the team descended down a cliff with cables. They proceeded toward various cave structures before Sobeck's [[Anooba/Legends|anoobas]] found and attacked the group. The anoobas grievously injured Piell, who gave Tano his knowledge of the Nexus Route prior to succumbing to his injuries and dying. Fives, as well as the remaining team members, were present during Piell's [[Funeral of Even Piell/Legends|funeral]] by a molten sulfur pit. Fives and the team proceeded to the rendezvous on an island, though Sobeck and a team of droids soon arrived, mounted on separate STAP speeders. The Citadel warden attacked and his speeder was shot down by Fives. Sobeck attacked Tarkin in a fit of rage because he couldn't get the information out of him, but Tano killed Sobeck. After arriving in the system with a rescue fleet of ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers, Koon rescued Fives and the team members with an LAAT/i gunship. The group returned to Coruscant shortly thereafter. Apart from Rex and Cody, Fives was the only surviving member of the original rescue party.<ref name="cr">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref>

===Battle of Umbara===
{{Quote|I am not just another number! None of us are!|Fives|<ref name="Plan of Dissent">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref>}}
After [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] seceded to the Separatists, Fives was reassigned on special assignment back to the 501st Legion when the Republic [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|invaded]] the planet of Umbara. After the 501st landed, Fives and [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]] were almost eaten by a [[Vixus/Legends|vixus]], but Fives was able to kill it by giving it a grenade. After the Umbarans' sneak attack and the Republic airstrike, Fives and the rest of the 501st Legion came under the command of Jedi Master [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]]. When Krell ordered the 501st to move across the main road, Fives and Rex did not approve of this course of action. The party then walked into mines, which Fives was able to locate, and were ambushed by the Umbarans. Fives fought until Captain Rex ordered the 501st to fall back. After repelling the natives' attack, Fives spoke up against General Krell, defending Captain Rex's actions despite being threatened by Krell.

Obi-Wan Kenobi, who was leading the 212th Attack Battalion, contacted Krell ordering him to take out an airbase that was supplying the capital. After Krell's plan to march straight down the narrow gorge at the airbase failed, and was causing heavy casualties, Fives was assigned, along with [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]], to infiltrate the base and commandeer two [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]] to destroy the enemy tanks.<ref name="DoU">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref>

[[File:501stLegion-Umbara.png|thumb|right|250px|Fives and the 501st after overtaking the Umbaran airbase]]
The 501st were then ready to attack the capital directly, but Krell was going to march directly on it without taking out a supply ship that was sending missiles down on the troops. Fives, along with Hardcase and Jesse, disobeyed Krell's direct orders and used the captured Umbaran starfighters to blow up the supply ship from the inside, at the cost of Hardcase's life. This resulted in Fives' and Jesse's court marshal. Rex tried to convince Krell not to court marshal them, but this only resulted in him ordering their execution. Fives reminded the troops that they were not droids, who follow orders unthinkingly, and said that Krell's orders were wrong. The execution squad purposefully missed Fives and Jesse, angering Dogma and Krell, though the latter decided to postpone the execution upon learning that the Umbarans had seized clone armor and weaponry.

Rex found out that the attack was actually set up by Krell as an act of betrayal; the worst loss of all was Waxer. After making plans to arrest their general, Rex and the others freed Fives and Jesse to assist them in arresting Krell. Pursuing him into the forest, Krell told Rex he should've listened to Fives when he said he was using the captain's loyalty to fuel his scheme. Ultimately, the clones captured Krell due to some resourcefulness from Fives' friend [[Tup/Legends|Tup]]. Upon learning from Krell that the Umbarans were making their way to the airbase and how he intended to make his escape when he did, Rex spoke with Fives, Jesse and Tup about what to do with Krell, ultimately agreeing that Krell would have to die. As Rex made ready to shoot Krell, Dogma, who had been sent to the brig and become destraught by Krell's betrayal, was set free by Jesse. Before Rex could shoot Krell, dogma took one Fives's pistols and shot Krell himself.

In the aftermath of the battle, the Republic finally succeeded in taking Umbara. Before shipping off, Rex asked Fives what the whole point to fighting the war. Fives said he didn't know, that he wasn't sure any of them knew, but he was sure the war would one day end, though Rex admitted his unpleasant feelings about the future.

===The Biochip Conspiracy===
{{Quote|Rex....This...it's...bigger than any of us...than anything...I could've imagined....All I ever meant to...I only wanted to do my duty....Brother....The mission...the nightmares...they're finally...over....|Fives' last words|<ref name="Orders" />}}
During a mission on the orbital ring space station of [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]], Tup suddenly began to act irrationally, switching between periods of normality and a strange trance-like state. In the latter condition, he inexplicably opened fire on Jedi Master [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]], killing her. A medical check proved to be inconclusive, so Tup was to be sent to Kamino for further investigation. However, just before the transport could get underway, the shuttle was ambushed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces and Tup was kidnapped.<ref name="The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>

Fives participated in the subsequent successful retrieval of Tup alongside Anakin Skywalker and Captain Rex, and as another transport was prepared, he asked Rex to come along in order to be with his friend; a request that was granted.<ref name="The Unknown" /> Upon arriving in Kamino, Fives bore witness to Tup's deteriorating condition as the check went underway, even though strangely no clue was found to the trooper's apparent irrationality. However, Tup's condition awoke concerns among the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], and they decided to contact [[Dooku/Legends|Master Tyranus]]. As it turned out, Tup's condition resulted from an organic biochip implanted in the brain of all clone troopers at an early stage of their embryonal development,<ref name="Fugitive">{{TCW|Fugitive}}</ref> with Tup's chip suffering an unexpected malfunction. The Kaminoans were told that the chip and the [[Order 66/Legends|programming it contained]] (referred to as Clone Protocol, or, more famously, Order 66) was meant as a safety measure in the case the Jedi went rogue, so that all clone troopers would ultimately (and ostensibly) remain obedient to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In order to keep this from Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], Kamino's Jedi supervisor, [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]], the physician in charge of the investigation, attempted to manipulate and falsify (or hide) the results of Tup's medical check.

[[File:FivesOnTheLam-Fugitive.png|thumb|left|250px|Fives holds Nala Se at gunpoint]]
However, Fives, desperate to save his friend and brother, launched an investigation of his own, assisted by the medical droid [[AZI-345211896246498721347/Legends|AZI-3]], whom he managed to persuade that acting against the rules would help save Tup's life. By performing a deep-reaching brain scan, Fives and AZI-3 discovered the biochip hidden in Tup's brain and retrieved it, but the operation and Tup's deteriorated condition inadvertently resulted in Tup's demise.<ref name="Conspiracy" /> When Fives subsequently learned from AZI-3 that his memory was to be erased and he was to be reassigned to the medical station of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] (an intention of which Shaak Ti bore no knowledge), he escaped custody and, after leaving a false trail, sneaked into the clone laboratories to find out whether all the clones had been tampered with. After finding this evidence - and having his own chip removed by AZI-3, he presented the facts to Shaak Ti, who ordered the chips and Fives to be brought to Coruscant for a presentation of his case to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], not knowing that she was actually playing right into the enemy's hands.<ref name="Fugitive" />

However, en route to Coruscant, Fives was drugged by Nala Se to slow his reactions. Upon hearing the facts, Palpatine insisted upon a private discussion with Fives and then faked an attempt on his own life, making Fives a marked fugitive. When the Jedi Council learned of this alleged attack, they decided to launch a secret investigation of their own, with Anakin and Rex deciding to find and approach Fives in order to find out the truth. While trying to lose his pursuers, Fives ran into his fellow trooper [[Kix/Legends|Kix]] and tried to relay the horrendous news to him. Kix arranged a meeting with Anakin and Rex, the only people Fives still trusted, but Fives was spotted and tracked down to the meeting point. In the meantime, Fives tried to plead his case to Anakin and Rex, even trapping the pair in [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]], but his drug-hazed state and his own agitation made his explanations about a [[Order 66/Legends|conspiracy against the Jedi]] and the Chancellor's involvement sound incoherent. When [[Fox/Legends|Commander Fox]] and a platoon of [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|Coruscant guards]] appeared to take Fives in, the desperate ARC Trooper tried to keep them away with Rex's pistol, but was fatally shot by Fox. Dying in Rex's arms, Fives reiterated Tup's last words about the "mission" and having found freedom at last.<ref name="Orders" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That's why he's the ARC Trooper.|Rex, commenting on Fives' creativity to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="The Unknown" />}}
[[File:FivesArmor-TCW.png|thumb|right|350px|Fives's armor from rookie to custom 501st colors to Phase I ARC Trooper to Phase II ARC Trooper.]]
Unlike the other rookie clone troopers stationed at Rishi Station, who had been there for some time,<ref name="rookies" /> Fives was sent to the base directly prior to Grievous' invasion.<ref name="Rookies Ep Guide" /> When he learned of his first assignment, he was proud to serve at a listening post that was critical to the defense of Kamino.<ref name="ultbattles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> At Rishi Station, Fives became acquainted with the rookie clone troopers and Sergeant O'Niner. He was able to cooperate with the other clone troopers when commando droids invaded the station. Fives showed eagerness to be on the front lines of battle, and, as the clones attacked the droids inside the Rishi Station, Fives's eagerness caused him to become injured, with a blaster bolt almost hitting his arm.<ref name="rookies" />

Fives's dedication and service to the Republic earned him a spot within the Republic's 501st Legion. Like all rookie clone troopers, Fives's armor was sleek white and had no dust or damage from fighting because of his lack of combat prior to the Rishi moon battle. He had a "5" [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on the top right side of his forehead.<ref name="rookies" /> Fives also had a well-trimmed goatee and a standard clone hairstyle throughout the war, until prior to his death when he went bald to undergo a surgical procedure.

Although Fives was born and trained as a standard clone trooper, he had somewhat higher creativity than his peers, earning him the title of ARC trooper. Though he did not receive additional training since his promotion, he gained a few skills and experience as time passed, no longer being a <nowiki>''shiny''</nowiki>.

==Behind the scenes==
Fives was first featured in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," the fifth episode in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], which aired on [[October 24]], [[2008]]. Like all clone troopers throughout the series, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Rookies Ep Guide" /> Fives's clone designation number&mdash;CT-27-5555&mdash;was revealed in the episode.<ref name="rookies" /> Fives was given an entry in the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and in the [[2009]] visual guide [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'']].

Fives later appeared in the episodes "[[Clone Cadets]]" and "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]" of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''The Clone Wars'', which aired on [[September 17]], [[2010]] as part of the season's premiere.<ref name="ccep">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode301.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets}}</ref><ref name="arcep">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode302.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: ARC Troopers}}</ref> Fives later appeared in the episodes "[[The Citadel (episode)|The Citadel]]," which aired on [[February 18]], [[2011]];<ref name="tcep" /> "[[Counterattack]]," which aired on [[March 4]], 2011;<ref name="caep" /> and "[[Citadel Rescue]]," which aired on [[March 11]], 2011.<ref name="cr ep">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}}</ref>
